mapper.select: select b.binding_id, b.biz_type, b.flow_id, b.create_by, b.create_time, f.flow_key, f.flow_name from pm_flow_binding b left join pm_flow_definition f on f.flow_id = b.flow_id where b.biz_type = #{bizType}
mapper.insert: insert into pm_flow_binding(biz_type, flow_id, create_by, create_time) values(#{bizType}, #{flowId}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update pm_flow_binding set flow_id = #{flowId} where binding_id = #{bindingId}
mapper.delete: delete from pm_flow_binding where binding_id in #{id}
